children.name: Syncrossus berdmorei
children.description: Syncrossus berdmorei is a freshwater fish in the loach family Botiidae.

children.name: Syncrossus helodes
children.description: Syncrossus helodes, commonly known as banded loach, tiger botia or lesser katy loach, is a freshwater fish in the loach family Botiidae.

children.name: Syncrossus beauforti
children.description: Synocrossus beauforti, the barred loach, chameleon loach or chameleon botia, is a species of freshwater fish from the loach family Botiidae which is found in mainland south-east Asia.

children.name: Syncrossus hymenophysa
children.description: Syncrossus hymenophysa, commonly known as the tiger loach, tiger botia or green tiger loach, is a species of freshwater fish in the loach family Botiidae.

children.name: Leptobotia elongata
children.description: Leptobotia elongata, the imperial flower loach, elongate loach or royal clown loach, is a species of botiid fish found in flowing water in the upper and middle Yangtze basin in China.

children.name: Yasuhikotakia modesta
children.description: Yasuhikotakia modesta (blue botia) is a tropical freshwater fish of the family Botiidae.

children.name: Botia lohachata
children.description: Botia lohachata, the reticulate loach, painted loch or Pakistani loach, is a species of freshwater ray-finned fish belonging to the family Botiidae, the pointface loaches.

children.name: Botia udomritthiruji
children.description: Botia udomritthiruji (emperor loach) is a small freshwater fish in the loach family Botiidae native to the Great Tenasserim (Tanintharyi) River Basin in south Burma.

children.name: Botia rostrata
children.description: Botia rostrata, the Gangetic loach, ladder loach, or twin-banded loach, is a freshwater fish belonging to the loach family Botiidae.

children.name: Botia dario
children.description: Botia dario (Bengal loach or queen loach) is a species of fish in the loach family Botiidae found in the Brahmaputra and Ganges basins in Bangladesh, Bhutan and northern India.

children.name: Botia birdi
children.description: Botia birdi, the Birdi loach, inhabits freshwater environments and is commonly found in India and Pakistan, particularly within the Indus drainage system.

children.name: Ambastaia nigrolineata
children.description: Ambastaia nigrolineata is a vulnerable species of loach found in the Mekong basin in Southeast Asia and China.
